components.text: Breaks the sire bond of the one on the centre. The sire stays on record, but the bond is gone.
Full-moon night only. Only a witch, siphoner, heretic or tribrid can work it. The target must be sired with the bond whole, and Sire's Blood of their own sire must be among the items.

A refusal tells the caster why and gives the ingredients back.

Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.
